title: FACEBOOK LEADS
*THAT BOOK*
slides.sub: Five fixes for what happens after the form.

title: 9PM IN
*BRUNSWICK*
slides.body: Someone taps your ad on the couch, submits in ten seconds, then lets your 9am call go to voicemail.

title: PUT THE DIARY
*IN THE FORM*
slides.body: Meta now shows your calendar after the Instant Form. They pick a time without leaving Facebook. Switch it on and walk away? (famous last words)

title: SHOW TIMES
*THIS WEEK*
slides.body: A plumber in Frankston with slots three weeks out gets no bookings. People book what's easy.

title: NAME IT LIKE
*A HUMAN*
slides.body: "Free 15 minute phone quote" gets booked. "Consultation Type B" gets scrolled past.

title: ASK WHICH
*SUBURB*
slides.body: One question before the calendar. Your Fitzroy business has no reason to book a job in Werribee (two hours of traffic, zero profit).

title: KEEP
*CALLING*
slides.body: The calendar catches the ready ones. Everyone else still gets a call within the hour. Booking tools don't pick up phones.
